svg.title: TabICL v2 - classifier
svg.desc: soda-inria - column set transformer -> row encoder -> in-context stack · 27.6 M parameters. Symbols in shapes: B: ensemble members (batch); n: rows in the context (train + test); p: raw features; F: feature groups; E: embedding width; n_test: test rows (the rows being predicted). Abbreviations: ICL: in-context learning: test rows attend to the labelled training rows; CLS: learned summary token that reads out a row or column; RoPE: rotary position embedding; MLP: multilayer perceptron (the feed-forward sublayer); GELU: Gaussian error linear unit (activation); LayerNorm: layer normalisation; KV: keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads). How to read: the data flows upwards, from the input table to the prediction; a line up the right-hand side ending in a circled plus: a residual connection, adding the input of the steps it passes back to their output; a box at the left meeting the flow at a circled plus: that stage's output is added to the flow; concat / prepend: a stage's output joins as an extra column, or as learned rows or columns put in front; N ×: the steps in the tinted container are stacked N times; small boxes at the left feed the step their arrow points to; dark boxes are attention; the line under the name says where its keys come from, which tokens query in the last block, how it is scaled, and how many key/value heads the test rows read; beside the arrows: the tensor shape each stage emits, in the symbols above; dotted lines: facts about the part they point to, with the numbers in the model's colour.
svg.text: soda-inria - column set transformer -> row encoder -> in-context stack · 27.6 M parameters
